usage: evidence-verify
       [-h]
       [--repo REPO]
       (--tree TREE |
       --revision REVISION)
       [--check CHECK]
       [--lanes-from COMMIT]
       [--lane-base COMMIT]
       [--require-all]
       [--project]
       [--paths PATH[,PATH...]]
       [--members]
       [--crate-key CRATE=KEY]
       [--keys KEYS |
       --keys-from KEYS_FROM]
       [--log-keys LOG_KEYS |
       --log-keys-from COMMIT]
       [--command COMMAND]
       [--run-input KEY=VALUE]
       [--kinds KINDS]
       [--policy-from COMMIT]
       [--repository REPOSITORY]
       [--max-age SECONDS]
       [--runner-prefix RUNNER_PREFIX]
       [--trust-levels TRUST_LEVELS]
       [--prefer-levels LEVELS]
       [--bind-input KEY=PATH]

Does a
trusted,
signed
evidence
note exist
for this
tree and
this check?

options:
  -h, --help
    show this
    help
    message and
    exit
  --repo REPO
  --tree TREE
  --revision REVISION
  --check CHECK
  --lanes-from COMMIT
    also hold
    the check
    to its lane
    definition
    in .st/requ
    ired-
    lanes.json
    at this
    accepted
    base: the
    lane's
    script
    blobs must
    be
    identical
    in the
    verified
    tree and
    the base (d
    efinition_c
    hanged) and
    the note
    must carry
    the base's
    digest (wro
    ng_definiti
    on)
  --lane-base COMMIT
    hold the
    lane to its
    definition
    at this
    commit (a
    pull
    request's
    branch
    point, an
    ancestor of
    the base
    with the
    same lane
    file)
    instead of
    at the
    base: a
    tree that
    only lags
    main is not
    a lane edit
  --require-all
    judge every
    check whose
    policy says
    `require`
    (needs
    --policy-
    from, --rep
    ository and
    keys); exit
    1 only when
    a check in
    mode reject
    is not
    satisfied,
    exit 2
    (decision
    error) when
    it could
    not decide
  --project
    print the
    input key
    of the tree
    for the
    check's
    declared
    paths and
    exit (needs
    no keys)
  --paths PATH[,PATH...]
    with
    --project:
    declared
    paths
    instead of
    the
    policy's
  --members
    a per-crate
    check:
    satisfied
    only when
    every
    workspace
    member of
    the tree
    has a
    satisfying
    note for
    its own key
    (needs
    --policy-
    from;
    accepts
    --lane-
    base; reads
    manifests
    without
    fetching;
    the keys
    come from s
    cripts/rust
    -test-keys
    next to
    this script
    and
    .st/rust-
    test-
    inputs.json
    at the
    base). With
    --project:
    print the
    member keys
    and stop
  --crate-key CRATE=KEY
    a per-crate
    check
    (docs/per-
    crate-test-
    signing.md)
    : only
    records
    that signed
    this crate
    and this
    input key
    count,
    whichever
    tree they
    are for (sc
    ripts/rust-
    test-keys
    prints the
    keys)
  --keys KEYS
    allowed-
    signers
    file
  --keys-from KEYS_FROM
    read .st/ev
    idence-keys
    from this
    commit (the
    accepted
    base)
  --log-keys LOG_KEYS
    allowed-
    signers
    file of the
    evidence
    log key:
    adds the
    log's
    shadow view
    (refs/evide
    nce-
    log/main)
  --log-keys-from COMMIT
    read .st/ev
    idence-log-
    key from
    this commit
    (none
    there: no
    log view)
  --command COMMAND
    JSON
    argument
    vector the
    record must
    have run
  --run-input KEY=VALUE
    this run's

    of an input
    the

    input_order
    compares a
    record's

    )
  --kinds KINDS
    comma-
    separated
    record
    kinds this
    check
    accepts
    (default: n
    ix,wrapper,
    sekrets,obs
    erved)
  --policy-from COMMIT
    apply the
    skip policy
    .st/evidenc
    e-skip-
    policy.json
    read from
    this
    accepted
    base (needs
    --repositor
    y)
  --repository REPOSITORY
    OWNER/NAME,
    filled into

    eholders

    reject a
